purpose: Training-only mechanism diagnostic for native FLARE source confusion before a broader sweep
controls: Hash-select one pure person per source from the approved240-person dense training pool, not by ancestry errors; exclude every evaluation/reference identity
stage_scope: Isolate FLARE first on matched observed GTs. Future raw-GT, phase-only and phase+imputed tracks are all permitted pipeline placements; none is presumed best.
template: Fresh reference-only native copying initialization on a selected training control; retain p/rho/theta, T=10 and uniform seven-source mu for explicit fixed-model contrasts
parameters_held_fixed: Original exact observed-marker panels/reference IDs/GTs/genetic map/seed, rho, generation and uniform priors; only predeclared p/theta/EM contrasts change
stock_check: Run pinned stock jar on hash-selected training SAS control per mask and compare local posteriors/global physical aggregation with the precision jar
truth: Pure one-hot labels only; no evaluation labels or predictions used; chr22 diagnostics not whole-genome certification
